text: {"status":"partial","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview Document states a total approved budget of $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states that the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 following a December 2026 Finance Committee revision.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown describes its quarterly table figures as the originally approved budget.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget."}]},{"text":"The Project Overview Document gives a planned launch date of March 15, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s3","quote":"the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027 to allow additional time for smart TV integration testing"}]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[0,1]},{"topic":"Public launch date","claim_indexes":[3,4]}],"missing":["The documents don't state which document is the most up to date.","The documents don't designate one budget figure as the correct one to use."],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
